fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM84,230. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0057151/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: ONE (1) Credit in Bahasa Melayu at SPM level AND TWO (2) C’s or 2.00 CGPA at STPM level including Pengajian Am (General Studies); OR THREE (3) A-levels; OR MSU Foundation Certificate; OR MSU Diploma in a relevant field with minimum 2.00 CGPA; OR Equivalent qualifications recognized by MSU Senate.
